stories.title: With help from monkeys, scientists build a leaner AI brain
stories.summary: Scientists have created an AI version of a monkey brain that recognizes images without requiring the massive computing power of existing AI systems.

stories.title: Ukraine's ambassador to the U.S. on power outages, resilience and peace
stories.summary: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Ukraine's Ambassador to the United States as Russia's war with Ukraine stretches into a fifth year.

stories.title: FBI Director Kash Patel faces scrutiny over travel on government jet
stories.summary: Democrats and others are raising questions about FBI Director Kash Patel's travel on a taxpayer-funded plane.

stories.title: Every month in Baker, Nev., people come out for a full moon hike
stories.summary: Among the cattle ranches and stretches of desert of Eastern Nevada, there aren't a lot of social events. But there is a full moon hike every month in the tiny town of Baker.

stories.title: Oyster harvesting returns to parts of North Florida bay after hiatus
stories.summary: Parts of the Apalachicola {APP-ah-LATCH-ih-KOH-lah} Bay re-opened for limited wild oyster harvesting after a five-year pause. Oyster eaters and fishermen are delighted.

stories.title: Her unsung hero stepped in when her dad couldn't be there
stories.summary: Olivia Joffrey's teacher organized a Father's Day softball game for students and their dads. But Joffrey's father was sick and not able to be there for his daughter. Her unsung hero stepped in.
